## Costs order following withdrawal

The applicant ⟦PERSON|Sorven Illick⟧ withdrew the application after ⟦ORG|Mallow Forge Logistics Ltd⟧ (the Respondent) supplied the missing records. The remaining issue is responsibility for the copying and attendance expenses incurred before those records became available.

The expenses bundle identifies the applicant's staff record by **Employee ID:** ⟦IDENTITY|PERSON_684209⟧. This is the literal row key exported from the employer's personnel register. Its spelling, including the underscore, is retained so that the receipts can be reconciled with the reimbursement entry.

The copying receipt is allowed in the amount of GBP 46. The attendance claim is reduced from GBP 120 to GBP 75 because part of the recorded time concerned preparation for an unrelated meeting. The applicant accepted that distinction when the time record was examined.

The respondent must pay GBP 121 within fourteen days. The order does not require payment of the unclaimed travel allowance and does not alter the earlier direction to preserve the original records. Any disagreement about the arithmetic must identify the individual item disputed.

The staff identifier is not a claim or case number. The references to section 5.2 and article 14 concern the costs procedure only.

Authenticated by ⟦PERSON|Nerith Valcott⟧, decision clerk.

Order dated 11 December 2026.
